baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive plural testimony noun at focus word 3 is governed by bi and followed by the enduring nominal qaimun at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge-based declarations are treated as charges over which the subject keeps watch, so standing is sustained custody and accurate discharge rather than a single courtroom moment.

activation_trace.role: Testifying from knowledge supplies the epistemic content; it is the declaration being preserved and discharged.
Care, guardianship, and preservation turn qaimun into sustained custody of the declarations.

changed_reading.before: They are people who give testimony when required.
changed_reading.after: They continuously stand over their several testimonies as charges to preserve and discharge accurately.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 3 and 4 couple witnessing with an explicitly upright human posture.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct presence and bodily standing combine into an ethic of showing up, remaining available, and personally bearing what one has witnessed.

activation_trace.role: Presence with witnessing supplies first-hand encounter; it makes testimony an act of being there.
Upright bodily standing supplies the posture; it makes the witness personally present and answerable.

changed_reading.before: Testimony is principally a true statement.
changed_reading.after: Testimony includes embodied availability: the witness shows up and stands personally behind what was seen.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The testimony noun at word 3 is joined to a plural agentive predicate at word 4, making witness a chosen undertaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge does not remain private: resolved undertaking gives it a visible tongue and carries it into public expression.

activation_trace.role: The witnessing tongue supplies overt expression; it turns inward knowledge into an audible or visible sign.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter supply volition; they make speaking the truth an assumed duty.

changed_reading.after: They take responsibility for giving that knowledge a public tongue instead of leaving it mute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural testimonies at word 3 can include signs, while the predicate at word 4 can describe straightness and evenness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Verbal claims and visible conduct form mutually checking signs; standing by testimony means keeping those signs aligned rather than allowing life and speech to diverge.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign that attests to a state supplies nonverbal corroboration; conduct can witness alongside speech.
Straightness and evenness supply alignment; they keep the several signs from contradicting one another.

changed_reading.before: Their testimony consists only of statements they utter.
changed_reading.after: Their speech and observable conduct remain upright together, each corroborating the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding trust-covenant-care complex makes testimony the next entrusted obligation in a custody chain: receive it, keep it through time, then stand ready to discharge it.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based testimony supplies what must eventually be declared from the witness's custody.
Guardianship and preservation supply the focus action; the witness continuously maintains the charge.
Security and trust supply the entrusted-object frame; testimony enters the same custody chain.
A preserved covenant supplies a commitment whose validity depends on continued keeping.
Attentive monitoring supplies the ongoing care that carries directly into testimonial standing.

structural_cues: 70:32 immediately precedes the focus and repeats the coordinated profile with possessive plural obligations followed by an enduring agent description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: adjacent trust, preserved covenant, and attentive care. Reader arrow: testimony is the next item entrusted to the same custody discipline. Live alternative: the clauses may list independent virtues without a transfer of mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Standing by testimony is a discrete virtue of accurate speech.
changed_reading.after: Standing by testimony is covenantal custody: knowledge is held faithfully across time and released without betrayal when due.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer's binding practice opens the ethical sequence with continuity and closes it with vigilant maintenance; framed by those poles, qaimun describes a repeated testimonial discipline rather than episodic performance.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration supplies the practice whose reliability must persist across occasions.
Persevering care supplies the durable mode of standing that the surrounding frame intensifies.
Prayer as binding worship supplies a recurrent practice, making the frame habitual rather than occasional.
Stillness and duration supply the opening temporal pole; witness is stabilized through time.
Adherence and continual observance supply the closing pole; testimonial standing becomes maintained practice.

structural_cues: The ethical profile begins with prayer in 70:22-23 and returns to prayer immediately after the focus in 70:34, bracketing every intervening trait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: binding worship, duration, and continual observance at the two edges of the list. Reader arrow: the temporal frame governs the focus predicate as well. Live alternative: the frame may characterize the group globally without specifying how testimony is performed.

changed_reading.before: They rise to testify at isolated moments.
changed_reading.after: They cultivate witness as a stable practice, with the same continuity and vigilance that frame their worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed and known due, an asking claimant, and truthful verification recast testimony as public infrastructure by which entitlements remain knowable and claimable, especially for one who lacks power.

activation_trace.role: Decisive declaration from knowledge supplies the evidence by which a contested or neglected due can be made public.
A mainstay that lets a thing remain standing supplies the institutional support testimony gives to claims.
Asking and requesting supply the claimant whose due needs an answerable public mechanism.
A binding obligation and fixed entitlement supply the right that testimony helps keep effective.
Disclosure to a knower supplies determinacy; the due is not left vague or privately manipulable.
Truthful speech supplies the verification standard that keeps the public evidence aligned with reality.

structural_cues: Within the same profile, 70:24-26 moves from a fixed known due to the requester and deprived person and then to verification before reaching testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: a fixed known entitlement, a requester, and truthful verification. Reader arrow: standing testimony is the social mechanism that keeps such claims publicly enforceable. Live alternative: the adjacent units may concern almsgiving and eschatological affirmation independently of testimony.

changed_reading.before: Testimony mainly demonstrates the speaker's personal integrity.
changed_reading.after: Maintained testimony supports other people's rights by keeping facts and entitlements publicly available to claimants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence of gathering and containerizing is reversed at the focus: what the witness knows is not warehoused for private control but brought out through an undertaken public tongue when disclosure is owed.

activation_trace.role: The witnessing tongue supplies public expression; it releases knowledge from private retention.
Resolve to undertake a matter supplies the decision to disclose rather than remain silent.
Gathering scattered things into a whole supplies the accumulation pole that testimonial disclosure reverses.
Putting a thing into a container supplies retained storage; here it models evidence withheld under private control.

structural_cues: 70:17-18 joins turning away with a compact gather-then-container sequence, while the focus later joins testimony to active undertaking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: accumulation, containment, a witnessing tongue, and resolved undertaking. Reader arrow: the positive witness reverses the negative storage pattern by disclosing owed knowledge. Live alternative: the earlier containment may refer only to material wealth and carry no evidentiary analogy.

changed_reading.before: A witness avoids lying when speaking.
changed_reading.after: A witness also refuses to hoard relevant knowledge in silence when another's claim requires its release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering of truth supplies the adversarial operation against which knowledge-based and sign-bearing testimony must remain upright: witness prevents erasure by making reality manifest and durable.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign attesting to a state supplies manifestation; it lets concealed reality leave an inspectable mark.
Resolute undertaking supplies resistance; the witness actively stands against suppression.
Covering truth supplies the opposing operation; maintained testimony counters that concealment.

structural_cues: The covering root appears near the surah's opening and returns immediately after the ethical group and its reward, creating a broad contrast around the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: a branch of truth-covering and focus branches of visible attestation and resolve. Reader arrow: the focus ethic is an anti-concealment practice. Live alternative: the context root may denote theological rejection broadly rather than suppression of particular evidence.

changed_reading.before: Testimony is a positive act of truthful reporting.
changed_reading.after: Testimony is also resistance to the covering and disappearance of truth from public view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby guard-boundary-transgression sequence transfers as a material analogy to evidence: a witness keeps speech within what was actually seen or known, neither crossing the limit through embellishment nor abandoning the guarded truth.

activation_trace.role: Testifying from knowledge supplies the epistemic boundary: the declaration may extend only as far as knowledge.
Straightness and evenness supply disciplined alignment at that boundary.
Watching and guarding a thing supply active boundary maintenance.
Seeking beyond a limit through aggression supplies the model for evidentiary overreach.
Crossing a boundary unjustly names the failure that disciplined testimony avoids.

structural_cues: 70:29-31 presents guarding, an explicit exception, seeking beyond it, and a verdict of transgression immediately before the trust-testimony pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: guarding and two images of unjust limit-crossing beside knowledge-based testimony. Reader arrow: the bodily and legal boundary becomes an analogy for the limits of evidence. Live alternative: the context mechanism may remain confined to sexual ethics and not transfer to speech.

changed_reading.before: An upright witness says something factually true.
changed_reading.after: An upright witness polices the edge of knowledge, refusing both exaggeration beyond it and neglect of what lies within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attempts and powers of substitution activate the focus root's standing-in-another's-place branch inversely: the possessive testimonies remain personally answerable and cannot be ransomed, delegated, or replaced by another's witness.

activation_trace.role: Declaration from one's own knowledge supplies the personal content that another cannot reproduce by substitution.
Standing in another's place supplies the substitution possibility; the possessive focus construction blocks it for personal witness.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies attempted transfer of consequence.
One thing taking another's place supplies the explicit replacement operation against which personal testimony is tested.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 cascades through proposed substitutes, while 70:41 later asserts the power to replace persons; the focus alone marks the testimonies possessively as theirs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: ransom, replacement, a substitution branch of standing, and possessive testimony. Reader arrow: testimonial responsibility is the nontransferable case within the surah's substitution field. Live alternative: ransom and replacement may concern punishment and populations only.

changed_reading.before: They ensure that valid testimony is available.
changed_reading.after: They personally answer for their own witness; neither kin, payment, nor a replacement can stand in for what only they know.

context_deltas.mechanism: The day of accounting and the later emergence from graves activate resurrection within qaimun: present fidelity to testimony becomes an anticipatory stance for the final setting in which persons and evidence must stand.

activation_trace.role: Decisive testimony from knowledge supplies the evidence carried into accountability.
Resurrection and creatures rising before their Lord supply the final-standing horizon for present qaimun.
A day's event and severity supply the bounded occasion toward which testimonial responsibility points.
Accounting and requital supply the juridical function of that day.
Passing out from an enclosure supplies the bodily emergence that turns the final standing concrete.
The grave supplies the enclosure from which persons emerge into accountability.

structural_cues: The profile explicitly affirms the accounting day in 70:26, and 70:42-44 closes the surah by depicting that promised day's emergence and exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: accounting, a severe day, emergence from graves, and the focus root's resurrection branch. Reader arrow: faithful witness now rehearses the stance required then. Live alternative: qaimun may denote only present maintenance, with resurrection remaining a distant lexical resonance.

changed_reading.before: They maintain testimony for present human proceedings.
changed_reading.after: Their present testimonial stance anticipates final accounting, training them to stand with evidence when every person is brought out.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated asking and calling activate qaimun as a station: testimony is not merely stored but kept available so that a witness can be summoned and answer a claim at the needed moment.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based testimony supplies the answer that becomes due when a claim is raised.
A standing-place, station, and residence supply readiness; the witness remains locatable and available.
Asking and requesting supply the claim that calls evidence into service.
Calling by speech supplies summons; the standing witness is one who can answer rather than evade.

structural_cues: Asking recurs at 70:1, 70:10, and 70:25, while calling appears at 70:17, giving the surah a repeated summons-and-response field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supply: repeated request, verbal summons, knowledge-based declaration, and a standing station. Reader arrow: qaimun implies testimonial availability on call. Live alternative: the questions and call serve unrelated scenes and may not summon a human witness.

changed_reading.before: They retain testimony as a settled possession.
changed_reading.after: They keep testimony stationed for use, remaining reachable and ready to answer when a claimant or proceeding calls.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because honey remaining in its comb is materially distant from legal testimony. It remains anchored in a branch of the focus testimony root and is reinforced by the following guard image; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory analogy for preserving evidentiary context, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The testimony root at focus word 3 carries the comb image, while qaimun at word 4 supplies guardianship over what is held intact.

activation_trace.role: Honey still in its comb before pressing supplies an intact contents-and-matrix image for unfragmented evidence.
Guardianship and preservation supply the witness's task of keeping that evidentiary matrix intact.
Watching and guarding a thing reinforce preservation against loss or premature extraction.

changed_reading.before: Faithful testimony preserves the correct proposition.
changed_reading.after: Faithful testimony also preserves the surrounding evidentiary matrix, resisting pressure to extract convenient fragments from their context.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the blind but structurally intact eye is a remote branch of the focus standing root. Direct witnessing and the later sight cue keep the contrast anchored; downstream prose should use it as a caution about hollow formal compliance, not claim that the positive group is blind.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins direct witnessing at word 3 to standing at word 4, allowing a contrast between perceptive witness and a merely intact standing form.

activation_trace.role: Presence with witnessing supplies actual perceptual contact, the substance a valid witness needs.
An eye whose globe remains intact after sight is lost supplies the danger of form standing after function has vanished.
Eyesight supplies the context's explicit perceptual axis, sharpening the difference between seeing and intact appearance.

changed_reading.before: A formally maintained testimonial procedure is sufficient.
changed_reading.after: Praised standing requires live perception and presence; an intact witness-form emptied of sight is not the focus virtue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because exact coin weight and division into shares are branch-distant material images. They remain anchored in qaimun, knowledge-based testimony, and the nearby fixed-right field; downstream prose should qualify the result as a measurement analogy for impartial evidence rather than a claim about literal weighing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Knowledge-based testimony at focus word 3 is coupled to a standing root at word 4 whose inventory includes exact, non-overweight measure.

activation_trace.role: Testifying from knowledge supplies the evidence whose weight must answer to what is actually known.
Equal coin weight without excess supplies calibration; testimony must neither overweight nor underweight a claim.
A specific right owned by its holder supplies the entitlement that distorted evidentiary weight could misallocate.
Separating and distributing a share supplies the allocation operation for which calibrated evidence matters.

changed_reading.before: They preserve testimony without altering its words.
changed_reading.after: They also keep its evidentiary weight even, refusing exaggeration or diminution that would skew another person's fixed share.

strongest_changes: The immediate trust-covenant-care clause turns testimony into an entrusted charge held faithfully across time.
Prayer's duration and guarding bracket the list, making testimonial standing a maintained discipline rather than an episodic act.
The fixed known due, requester, and truthful verification make testimony infrastructure for other people's claimable rights.
The accounting day and emergence from graves activate present witness-standing as an anticipatory stance for final accountability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots support an unusually productive interaction between knowledge, presence, speech, guardianship, posture, and structural support. Context most sharply changed the reading through immediate covenant and prayer frames, while hoarding, concealment, substitution, and branch-distant material images preserved additional live mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The public-rights model may arise from list adjacency rather than a direct causal link between giving, verification, and testimony.
The resurrection branch of qaimun is strongly activated by the ending but may remain resonance rather than the focus predicate's primary sense.
The comb, blind-eye, and exact-weight readings are branch-backed analogies whose value depends on careful downstream qualification.
